description: Defines the URLRequestThrottlerManager class responsible for managing URL request throttling, including registration, garbage collection, and network change handling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: URLRequestThrottlerManager
classes.description: Manages URL request throttler entries, handles registration, garbage collection, network changes, and enforces throttling policies.

methods.name: RegisterRequestUrl
methods.description: Registers a URL request and returns its throttler entry.

methods.name: OverrideEntryForTests
methods.description: Overrides or adds a throttler entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: EraseEntryForTests
methods.description: Removes a throttler entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: enforce_throttling
methods.description: Checks if throttling enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: set_net_log
methods.description: Sets the NetLog instance for logging.

methods.name: GetIdFromUrl
methods.description: Generates a unique ID from a URL for internal mapping.

methods.name: GarbageCollectEntriesIfNecessary
methods.description: Performs garbage collection if needed based on request count.

methods.name: GarbageCollectEntries
methods.description: Performs actual garbage collection of outdated entries.

methods.name: OnNetworkChange
methods.description: Resets back-off history on network changes.

methods.name: GetNumberOfEntriesForTests
methods.description: Returns the number of current entries, used for testing.
